Concrete ExploreDataset backend over a parquet directory

Source: R/ExploreDatasetParquet.R
ExploreDatasetParquet.Rd

The exploreDElight backend. Reads the parquet directory a native Rust process writes from a canonical exploreDE/1.0 .h5ad, and satisfies the same accessor contract as every other backend. Inherits all config derivation and DE assembly from ExploreDatasetH5AD; only the loader differs.

ExploreDatasetParquet$new()

Read the parquet directory (manifest, obs, var, layers, varm, uns), build the config, prepare the feature and DE tables, and warn when the source .h5ad has changed since export.

Usage

ExploreDatasetParquet$new(input)

Arguments

input

Path to the parquet directory.

ExploreDatasetParquet$verify_source()

Compare the md5 of the source .h5ad with the one recorded in the manifest: TRUE when it matches, FALSE when not, NA when there is nothing to check against.

Usage

ExploreDatasetParquet$verify_source(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the source .h5ad; NULL (default) uses the path recorded in the manifest.
